_comment: The locale census allowlist (P2 S11). localeCensus.test.ts counts, per production file under src/ and extensions/,
the shapes that format or parse a number outside the app locale: .toFixed(, parseFloat(, Number(e.target.value) /
Number(raw), and the display re-parse .replace(/[^0-9. A file may hold at most the counts listed here; any other
file holds none. Display text and user input go through @api/locale (formatNumber / parseNumber) instead.
Every entry carries a reason: css-px, geometry, log, wire (an invariant value: a stored literal, an option or range
value, a language token, an integer-only box), internal (a number that never becomes text), script-source (code inside
a script template), test-harness (the dev-only TestRunner) or unloaded (built by nothing). An unclassifiable display
hit is fixed, not listed. Comment-only lines are not counted. Lower a count when you remove a hit: a stale count fails.
